notes: Erie County Republican county committee members are elected at the June 23, 2026 primary (BOE 'Offices to be Elected' lists Member of County Committee for Republicans). ED list: 652 EDs from the BOE 2026 Apportionment Book (Buffalo 208, Lackawanna 20, City of Tonawanda 12, towns 412); codes cross-checked against the 2026 general poll-site list (which omits Town of Tonawanda ED 8). Filers: 'COUNTY COMMITTEE MEMBER' rows with party R in the BOE Petitions Log dated 7/28/2026 (567 Republican filers in 316 EDs). This is a log of petitions filed; it does not show withdrawals, declinations or invalidations, so a few 'filled' seats may belong to filers who were later removed. Seats: 2 per ED, from 'Vote for Any Two' on the BOE primary candidate list; no other ED had more than 2 Republican filers. Town of Amherst ED 57 was the only contested Republican county committee race (5 petitions filed, 4 on the ballot); its results were not found (the official Republican canvass book contains only the Collins Town Justice race), so both seats are unknown. Uncontested filers are deemed elected; seats without a Republican filer are empty_no_filer (vacancies may since have been filled by appointment).
